findings.title: Indemnity carved out of aggregate liability cap
findings.impact: AtliQ risks unlimited financial exposure for indemnification claims under the agreement.

citations.quote: Neither party liable for consequential damages. Each party's aggregate liability capped at fees paid or payable under the applicable SOW, except for confidentiality breaches and indemnity

findings.standard: Each party's aggregate liability capped at 1× fees (paid or payable in the prior 12 months), mutual; carve-outs only for fraud, wilful misconduct and confidentiality (plus any carve-outs that are mandatory under the governing law, e.g. German law for intent/gross negligence and injury).
findings.counterPosition: Limit liability cap carve-outs to confidentiality conflicts, fraud, willful misconduct, and IP infringement indemnification.

findings.impact: AtliQ could be forced to lower its contract pricing if it offers lower rates to any other US client during the 36-month term.

findings.title: Professional liability insurance limit requires verification
findings.impact: AtliQ must verify that its existing insurance policy covers $1,000,000 in professional liability.

citations.quote: Consultant shall maintain professional liability insurance of $1,000,000

findings.standard: Check every required insurance type and limit against what AtliQ actually holds before signing (known: cyber $1M; everything else unrecorded).
findings.counterPosition: Confirm AtliQ's current professional liability policy meets the $1,000,000 limit or adjust the contractual requirement to match existing coverage.

findings.title: Liquidated damages clause lacks sole remedy language
findings.impact: Cobalt could potentially seek additional damages for delay beyond the agreed liquidated damages.

citations.quote: Liquidated damages of 0.5% of the affected milestone fee per week of Consultant-caused delay, capped at 5% of that milestone fee

findings.counterPosition: Add explicit language stating that liquidated damages are Cobalt's sole and exclusive remedy for delay.

fine: Correct AtliQ entity: Inc for a USA counterparty
Governing law matches entity: laws of the State of Colorado (Inc → US law)
Net 30 days payment terms comply with AtliQ standard.
Termination for convenience provides 30 days' notice and payment for work performed.
Confidentiality provisions are mutual with a standard 3-year duration.
Deliverables transfer upon payment and AtliQ retains background IP with a non-exclusive licence.
60-day warranty for SOW conformity is standard.
Offshore processing in India is allowed provided customer personal data is not stored outside the US.
Mutual indemnity structure for IP, confidentiality, and gross negligence/willful misconduct is acceptable.
notSeen: Insurance: professional indemnity $1M required: AtliQ's professional indemnity cover isn't recorded anywhere. Confirm with finance.
Commitments were checked against all 27 signed contracts on file. Contracts AtliQ hasn't uploaded can't be checked.

hits.text:
10.1 Each Party (the "**Indemnifying Party**") shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless the other Party and its directors, officers and employees (the "**Indemnified Party**") from and against all Losses arising out of any third-party claim to the extent caused by: (a) the Indemnifying Party's breach of Clause 7 (Confidentiality) or Clause 12 (Data Protection); (b) the gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud of the Indemnifying Party or its personnel; or (c) in the case of AtliQ, any claim that the Deliverables infringe a third party's intellectual property rights, and in the case of PayTrack, any claim that Client Data or materials supplied by PayTrack infringe a third party's rights.

10.2 Neither Party shall be required to indemnify the other to the extent any Losses are caused by the negligence, breach or wilful misconduct of the Indemnified Party.

10.3 The Indemnified Party shall give prompt written notice of any claim, permit the Indemnifying Party to control the defence and settlement, and provide reasonable cooperation at the Indemnifying Party's cost.
hits.differs: Better for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: client provides mutual indemnity for confidentiality and gross negligence, rather than indemnifying solely for IP infringement.

7.1 If the Service Provider fails to complete a Milestone by the agreed date for reasons solely attributable to the Service Provider, the Service Provider shall pay liquidated damages at the rate of 0.5% (half percent) of the Milestone Fee of the delayed Milestone for each complete week of delay.

7.2 The aggregate liquidated damages in respect of any Milestone shall not exceed 5% (five percent) of the Milestone Fee of that Milestone.

7.3 No liquidated damages shall be payable where the delay is caused by the Client, including delayed access to data or systems, delayed review of Deliverables, or changes in scope, or by a Force Majeure event.

10.1 The Supplier shall use all reasonable endeavours to achieve each Milestone by the date set out in the relevant SOW.

10.2 Each Deliverable shall be subject to acceptance testing by the Client within ten (10) Business Days of delivery against the acceptance criteria in the SOW. Deliverables not rejected in writing within that period shall be deemed accepted.
